title: Smooth push-forward of integer multiplicity currents (P3)
statement: Assume LipschitzPushforwardIntegerMultiplicity (Simon 3.9). Let U ⊆ ℝ^P, V ⊆ ℝ^Q be open, X ∈ D_{k+1}(U) integer multiplicity, and f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q of class C^∞ with f(U) ⊆ V and f⁻¹(K) ∩ spt X compact for every compact K ⊆ V. Then there is an integer multiplicity S ∈ D_{k+1}(V) (the push-forward f_#X) such that: (1) S(ω) = X(η) whenever η ∈ D^{k+1}(U) agrees with the pull-back f^#ω on an open set containing spt X; (2) ∂S(ω) = ∂X(η) whenever ω ∈ D^k(V) and η ∈ D^k(U) agrees with f^#ω on an open set containing spt X; (3) if c ≥ 0 and ‖Df(x)‖ ≤ c for all x, then M_W(S) ≤ c^{k+1} M_{f⁻¹(W)∩U}(X) and M_W(∂S) ≤ c^k M_{f⁻¹(W)∩U}(∂X) for every W ⊆ ℝ^Q.
lean_statement: LipschitzPushforwardIntegerMultiplicity → ∀ (P Q k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (V : Set (Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → MapsTo f U V → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K ∩ X.support)) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn V (k + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ (ω : TestFormOn V (k + 1)) (η : TestFormOn U (k + 1)), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (k + 1)) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) (k + 1)) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) → S ω = X η) ∧ (∀ (ω : TestFormOn V k) (η : TestFormOn U k), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) k) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) → S.boundary ω = X.boundary η) ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ c) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl Q), S.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ (k + 1)) * X.massOn (f ⁻¹' W ∩ U) ∧ S.boundary.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ k) * X.boundary.massOn (f ⁻¹' W ∩ U)
